## `remove_global_default_path`

*Available in [R](#remove_global_default_path-r)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function removed the default path at the user level to access the project
    drive.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    remove_global_default_path()

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>
    *No arguments*
